{
  "name": "postiz-support-bot",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "description": "",
  "main": "dist/index.js",
  "scripts": {
    "build": "prisma generate && tsc && node dist/scripts/bundleWorkflows.js",
    "test": "node --test \"dist/temporal/__tests__/*.test.js\" \"dist/sla/__tests__/*.test.js\" \"dist/intercom/__tests__/*.test.js\" \"dist/config/__tests__/*.test.js\" \"dist/adminpanel/__tests__/*.test.js\" \"dist/util/__tests__/*.test.js\" \"dist/dashboard/__tests__/*.test.js\" \"dist/server/__tests__/*.test.js\" \"dist/sentry/__tests__/*.test.js\" \"dist/postiz/__tests__/*.test.js\" \"dist/categories/__tests__/*.test.js\" \"dist/bot/__tests__/*.test.js\" \"dist/db/__tests__/*.test.js\" \"dist/metrics/__tests__/*.test.js\" \"dist/resend/__tests__/*.test.js\" \"dist/queue/__tests__/*.test.js\"",
    "test:temporal": "TEMPORAL_TEST=1 node --test \"dist/temporal/__tests__/*.test.js\"",
    "start": "SENTRY_PRELOAD_INTEGRATIONS=Http,Express,Postgres node --require @sentry/node/preload dist/index.js",
    "dev": "prisma generate && SENTRY_PRELOAD_INTEGRATIONS=Http,Express,Postgres ts-node -r @sentry/node/preload src/index.ts",
    "db:migrate": "prisma migrate dev",
    "db:push": "prisma db push",
    "postinstall": "rm -rf search && mkdir search && cd search && git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/gitroomhq/postiz-app && git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/gitroomhq/postiz-docs"
  },
  "keywords": [],
  "author": "",
  "license": "ISC",
  "dependencies": {
    "@anthropic-ai/claude-code": "^2.1.81",
    "@anthropic-ai/sdk": "^0.110.0",
    "@influxdata/influxdb-client": "^1.35.0",
    "@modelcontextprotocol/sdk": "^1.29.0",
    "@prisma/adapter-pg": "^7.5.0",
    "@prisma/client": "^7.5.0",
    "@sentry/node": "10.63.0",
    "@sentry/profiling-node": "10.63.0",
    "@simplewebauthn/server": "^13.3.2",
    "@temporalio/activity": "1.20.2",
    "@temporalio/client": "1.20.2",
    "@temporalio/common": "1.20.2",
    "@temporalio/worker": "1.20.2",
    "@temporalio/workflow": "1.20.2",
    "discord.js": "^14.25.1",
    "dotenv": "^17.3.1",
    "express": "^5.2.1",
    "qrcode-generator": "^2.0.4",
    "stripe": "^20.4.1",
    "tar": "^7.4.3",
    "zod": "^4.4.3",
    "pg": "^8.20.0"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@temporalio/testing": "1.20.2",
    "@types/express": "^5.0.6",
    "@types/node": "^25.5.0",
    "prisma": "^7.5.0",
    "ts-node": "^10.9.2",
    "typescript": "^5.9.3",
    "@types/pg": "^8.11.11"
  },
  "pnpm": {
    "onlyBuiltDependencies": [
      "@sentry/profiling-node",
      "@temporalio/core-bridge"
    ]
  }
}
